modifications: Pinned upstream package; the executable and its resources are unmodified; the installer leaves out the development files of a statically linked library; the launcher adds first-run settings, a fixed uname text and a preloaded guard
configuration: seed.py answers the first-run questions in the product settings file under DATA_DIR (no usage statistics, no update or news check, no random money tips); start.sh keeps all product state under DATA_DIR, starts in the inbox folder, opens PBP_DATABASE when set and passes the product option --silent The preloaded guard permits only exact installed WebKit helper paths and fixed uname/lsb_release information options; no arbitrary command suffix is accepted.
